justification: Inspected the only two exact `package javaparser;` classes: `javaparser-symbol-solver-testing/src/test/resources/javassist_generics/javaparser/GenericClass.java` and `javaparser-symbol-solver-testing/src/test/resources/issue2667/javaparser/JSONObject.java`. `GenericClass.java` imports only `java.util.List` and `java.util.Map`; `JSONObject.java` has no imports. Both are heavily used as fixtures by tests/resources such as `GenericClassNavigator.java.txt`, `JarTypeSolverConstructorResolution.java.txt`, `Issue2667.java.txt`, and symbol-solver tests, so the package has multiple incoming references but only trivial outgoing dependencies to the JDK. That evidence does not show the package depending on less-stable packages, so UD is not present.
